idle verb

also be idle, loaf, loaf around, laze about, loaf about, sit on one’s hands

classical

Traupman 102: loaf

cessō, cessāre, cessāvī, cessātum

verb, first conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

Other words

  • ōtiō mē dēdō — give myself over to idleness

    also used · classical

  • langueō, languēre, languī — be weak or languid

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical · Conjugation on Wiktionary

    It does not by itself imply deliberate shirking.

Examples

  • Tōtum diem cessat.

    He idles all day / has been idling all day.composed

  • compressīs manibus sedēre

    to sit on one’s hands, sit idleLiv. 7.13.7 (Lewis & Short s.v. comprimō); Traupman 325

See also slack off.
